column4: The Arabian Sea shoreline at first light near Anjuna, bamboo crab traps stacked on black laterite rocks, sea spray.
Weathered hands of a fisherman selecting a large live mud crab from a woven basket of crabs, close up, water droplets on the shell.
Live mud crabs resting in a shallow brackish-water pen of woven bamboo among mangrove roots, calm dark water, soft morning light.
A cleaned mud crab on a banana leaf on a dark stone slab beside grated coconut, dried red chillies, kokum and curry leaves and a carbon-steel knife, three-quarter overhead angle.
Halved crab pieces glazed with red masala sizzling on a grill over a live wood fire, flames and embers, smoke curling.
A blackened earthen claypot on glowing coals, its lid slightly ajar, steam escaping, rich red crab curry glimpsed inside.
A finished crab dish in its claypot on a dark wooden table, candlelight, a hand reaching in with a piece of bread, tropical leaves blurred behind.
Red laterite cliffs of the Konkan coast dropping into a rough dark sea at dusk, palms on the clifftop.
Wooden outrigger fishing boats pulled up on a Goan beach at dusk, nets drying, palms, calm sea.
Kerala Malabar backwaters, a narrow wooden canoe gliding through still green water under coconut palms, misty.
A Coromandel coast fishing village at dawn, log catamaran boats on the sand, fishermen hauling nets.
The old Portuguese laterite fort at Aguada in Goa, its walls meeting the sea at sunset, a lighthouse.
Feet walking a stone path between tropical foliage and small lanterns toward a warm glowing entrance at night.
Hands holding a heavy textured paper menu by candlelight over a dark wood table.
A server's hands presenting a live mud crab on a bed of ice and banana leaf beside a lantern.
A cook at an open wood fire grill seen from behind in silhouette, flames leaping, sparks.
Thick fragrant smoke rising from a grill in the dark, lit by warm firelight, abstract.
Hands lifting the lid of an earthen claypot, a bloom of steam rising, dark background.
Close up of fingers breaking a crab claw over a claypot of rich sauce, candlelight.
A table late at night, a candle burning low, two glasses, the dark sea and a sliver of moonlight beyond.
Hands cracking a glossy cooked crab claw over a bowl of crab curry on a banana leaf.
A primitive wood fire pit with fish grilling on a rack of green sticks, flames and smoke, night.
A whitewashed Portuguese-era church and laterite houses of Old Goa beside a coastal road, tropical light, aged textures.
A potter's workshop stacked with earthen claypots drying in the sun, rough clay textures, long shadows.
Wide view of mangrove crab-fattening pens in brackish water at dawn, a fisherman wading between bamboo enclosures.

Botanical line illustrations in one consistent fine engraving style, drawn with clay-coloured #B8805A ink on a flat solid black background, six separate subjects evenly spaced in a 3 by 2 grid with generous gaps: a coconut half, a kokum fruit, a dried red chilli, a sprig of curry leaves, a small glass bottle of toddy vinegar, a cashew apple with its nut. No text, no labels, no borders.

Antique engraved sea chart illustration showing Portugal, the west coast of Africa, the Cape and the Arabian Sea up to India's west coast, fine smoked brown #4A3426 and clay #B8805A ink linework on a dark charcoal #1E1C19 ground, a compass rose, small sailing ships, aged paper texture. No route line, no text, no labels.

Seamless repeating azulejo tile pattern in fine line art, smoked brown #4A3426 and clay #B8805A lines on dark charcoal #1E1C19, Portuguese and Goan floral motif, tile edges that repeat seamlessly, flat, no text.
Macro texture of dark unglazed clay surface with fine grain and faint potter's fingerprints, low raking light, volcanic black and smoked brown, uniform, no objects, no text.
Macro texture of charred wood with cracked black char and faint glowing ember seams in burnt terracotta, low-key, uniform, no objects, no text.

Icon set sheet: twelve consistent minimal line glyphs with a 1.5px stroke, burnt terracotta #A8502F lines on a flat solid pure black background, arranged in an even 4 by 3 grid with wide spacing: crab, ocean wave, flame, earthen claypot, cast-iron pan, coconut, chilli, leaf, fish, seashell, clock, map pin. No text, no labels, no frames.

Stylized antique map illustration of the North Goa coastline from Arambol south to Aguada, with the Anjuna headland in the middle, the Chapora and Mandovi river mouths, beaches and headlands, fine clay #B8805A linework and smoked brown #4A3426 hatching on dark charcoal #1E1C19. No text, no labels, no roads, no markers.
A lone empty earthen claypot on wet sand at night as a wave recedes, moonlight, vast dark negative space.
A single glowing ember resting inside an open earthen claypot on dark stone, warm light rising, deep black background.
A steaming crab curry in a blackened claypot on dark wood, top-left light, generous dark negative space on the left third.
An open weathered notebook with ink sketches beside a claypot and dried chillies on dark wood, candlelight, generous dark negative space on the right.
A mud crab on black wet stone, extreme macro, droplets, terracotta rim light, dark negative space on the left.
